verified_with: Interactive PTY runs of the pinned release against a loopback Responses-API stub with a fresh CODEX_HOME in a network namespace with only loopback: idle, working (status row and streaming), the screen after a turn, tool-approval and background-terminal screens at widths 20 to 200 with their terminal titles, OSC 7501 program-status sequences of each scenario (idle, a turn, an approval, a background terminal that outlives its turn), `codex --version` banner and hook-trust records (SessionStart, Stop). The question, login, folder-trust, startup-dialog and update-popup screens are the captures of 0.160.0 (compat/codex/screens/n-1, startup-dialogs, update-popup); the SubagentStart, SubagentStop and child UserPromptSubmit hook inputs and their order in seven multi-agent flows (spawn, follow-up through send_input and followup_task, resume after close, an interrupted turn, a close of a running child)
